nodes.title: EXP 4 video / 8 audio (8 full H3 calls)

widgets_values:
Extreme close-up portrait of a female cultivator in dark green xianxia-style robes with gold embroidery and blue sheer sleeves, long straight black hair with bangs, intricate gold necklace with jade pendant. Cinematic facial acting sequence:

[0-3s] She stands calmly with a serene, composed expression, listening intently, her brown eyes steady and peaceful, soft golden lighting on her face.

[3-7s] Her eyes widen slightly in shock as if hearing devastating news, pupils contracting, lips parting almost imperceptibly. She quickly composes herself, forcing a faint, bitter smile at the corner of her mouth, but her eyes betray the pain beneath.

[7-12s] The forced smile lingers on her lips while her eyes gradually glisten with held-back tears. A single tear slowly wells up in her left eye, catching the light, then silently rolls down her cheek. Her smile trembles slightly but stays, heartbreakingly beautiful.

[12-15s] She closes her eyes for a brief moment, then opens them with newfound resolve. The tear trace glistens on her cheek. She turns her head away decisively, hair sweeping across the frame, her expression now cold and determined as she begins to leave.

Subtle camera push-in during the emotional peak, soft bokeh background of misty mountain peaks, ethereal spiritual energy particles floating in the air. Dramatic side lighting creating deep shadows on half her face, emphasizing the internal conflict. 8K, hyper-realistic skin texture, cinematic color grading, xianxia fantasy aesthetic, shallow depth of field, slow and deliberate pacing.
